description: Asset-level disposition ledger: one row per frozen RMDB asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.description: Frozen RMDB asset identifier (unique primary key).

fields.name: source_url_or_accession
fields.description: Source URL or accession of the raw asset.

fields.name: source_accession
fields.description: RMDB source accession (file base name without .rdat).

fields.name: asset_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the raw .rdat file if present on disk, else UNKNOWN_NOT_ASSERTED. Never fabricated.

fields.name: parser_version
fields.description: Parser/canonicalization version that produced the disposition.

fields.name: asset_parse_status
fields.description: PARSE_SUCCESS or explicit PARSE_FAIL_* category; never empty.

fields.name: n_profiles
fields.description: Number of distinct profiles for the asset from canonical_records_v2 (NOT_RUN if the 39GB count has not been produced).

fields.name: n_records
fields.description: Number of canonical records for the asset from canonical_records_v2 (NOT_RUN if the 39GB count has not been produced).

fields.name: n_exact_pairs
fields.description: Number of primary exact-delta pairs for the asset (NOT_RUN if not counted).

fields.name: profile_failure_rows
fields.description: Count of LENGTH_MISMATCH PROFILE rows for the asset (a profile count, never an asset count).

fields.name: unique_failure_reason
fields.description: Single most common profile parse failure reason, or the asset's own disposition if PARSE_FAIL, else NONE.

fields.name: license_status
fields.description: License status carried through from d0x_v2 (VERIFIED_CC0_RMDB).

fields.name: citation_resolution_status
fields.description: RESOLVED / UNRESOLVED_PUBLICATION / AMBIGUOUS from the accession registry.
